items.subtitle: Capital of Thailand
items.description: Bangkok, Thailand’s capital, is a large city known for ornate shrines and vibrant street life. The boat-filled Chao Phraya River feeds its network of canals, flowing past the Rattanakosin royal district, home to opulent Grand Palace and its sacred Wat Phra Kaew Temple. Nearby is Wat Pho Temple with an enormous reclining Buddha and, on the opposite shore, Wat Arun Temple with its steep steps and Khmer-style spire. ― Google

items.markdown:
![Bangkok city guide: Where to stay, eat, drink and shop in ...](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/07262156-1672-0139-0000-0c44ef5d69fe:22)
Bangkok is the `capital city of Thailand` , known for landmarks like the [Grand Palace](https://www.tripadvisor.co.uk/Tourism-g293916-Bangkok-Vacations.html) , Wat Pho, and Wat Arun. Founded in 1782, it serves as the country's spiritual, cultural, and commercial heart along the Chao Phraya River.[](https://www.britannica.com/place/Bangkok) [[1]](https://www.britannica.com/place/Bangkok)[[2]](https://www.tui.co.uk/destinations/asia/thailand/thailand/bangkok/holidays-bangkok.html)[[3]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bangkok)[[4]](https://www.tourismthailand.org/Destinations/Provinces/Bangkok/219)[[5]](https://fanclubthailand.co.uk/bangkok/)

Top Landmarks and Temples

- **The Grand Palace & Wat Phra Kaew** : Former royal residence housing the sacred Emerald Buddha; admission is 500 baht.
- **Wat Pho** : Home to a massive 46-meter gilded reclining Buddha and known as the birthplace of traditional Thai massage.
- **Wat Arun (Temple of Dawn)** : Riverfront temple decorated with colorful porcelain and seashells, best viewed at sunset.[](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=udR5K8L6K2Y&vl=en&t=14) [[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=udR5K8L6K2Y&vl=en&t=14)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9T8S_eDX8SE&t=22)[[3]](https://www.tui.co.uk/destinations/asia/thailand/thailand/bangkok/holidays-bangkok.html)[[4]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=u8qy1MgkrZk&t=248)[[5]](https://www.novotelbkk.com/destination/bangkok-tradition-and-culture-guide/wat-arun/)

Culture and Food

- **Street Food** : Bustling night markets and roadside stalls in Chinatown and across the city serve local favorites like khao geng and kuay jab.
- **Chatuchak Weekend Market** : Massive open-air market operating Friday through Sunday with thousands of stalls.
- **Canals and Rivers** : Boat travel on the Chao Phraya River remains a core part of daily transit and sightseeing.[](https://www.tripadvisor.co.uk/Tourism-g293916-Bangkok-Vacations.html) [[1]](https://www.tripadvisor.co.uk/Tourism-g293916-Bangkok-Vacations.html)[[2]](https://www.thaizer.com/bangkok/)[[3]](https://megapass.com/de/blog/bangkok-public-transport-tickets-passes-prices)[[4]](https://www.cestee.com/destination/thailand/bangkok/getting-around)

expanded_element.title: Bangkok - Wikipedia
expanded_element.snippet: Today, the city is officially known in Thai by a shortened form of the full ceremonial name, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon (กรุงเทพมหานคร ), which is colloquially further shortened to Krung Thep (กรุงเทพฯ ) or the initialism Ko Tho Mo (กทม. ).

items.title: What is the history of Bangkok?

expanded_element.title: History of Bangkok - From tiny village to top tourist destination
expanded_element.snippet: While there has been a small village on Chao Phraya River since the early 15th century, the city of Bangkok was officially founded as the country's capital in 1782 by King Rama I. Since then, the history, culture and language of the city have gone hand in hand with that of Thailand as a whole.
